title: Servicing Desk — Granting an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Installment Deferral
content:
**Rule.** On the member's request one scheduled installment of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is deferred to the end of the schedule on a product that offers deferrals, while the loan is in active status: the installment after the deferred one becomes the next due, the maturity date moves out by one installment period, the deferral count rises by one, the grant date becomes the last deferral date, and the deferral fee is booked on the grant date.

**Conditions on the grant and its fee.** The deferral fee is fixed only after the collateral records carry the release of every pledged unit that a submitted collateral release request names as destroyed in a total loss. A deferral of a loan with a unit released on the grant date other than at payoff is not granted until the balance tested against the post-release margin stands within that margin of the tested value of the units still pledged.

## What a grant changes on the loan

| Item | After the grant |
|---|---|
| Status | deferred |
| Next due date | the due date of the installment after the deferred one |
| Maturity date | moved out by one installment period |
| Deferral count | one more than before |
| Last deferral date | the grant date |
| Fees | one deferral fee entry booked on the grant date |

Hypothetical: a quarterly loan with a next due date of 15 June and a maturity date of 15 March 2030, deferral count 0, granted a deferral on 20 May: next due date 15 September, maturity date 15 June 2030, deferral count 1, last deferral date 20 May.

## The deferral tool: `grant_installment_deferral_57477c3f`

**Capability.** The tool grants a deferral of the next scheduled installment of a member's equipment or vehicle loan: the next installment moves to the end of the schedule, the loan is set to deferred status, its next due date and maturity date are set to the dates given, its deferral count is set to the count given, today becomes its last deferral date, and one deferral fee entry for the amount given is booked today and added to the loan's fees not yet paid. Afterwards the loan shows deferred with the new dates and the fee shows in its transaction history.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `grant_installment_deferral_57477c3f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member holding the loan, as returned by the member profile lookup | identifier |
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the equipment loan whose installment is deferred, as returned by the equipment loan lookup | identifier |
| `next_due_date` | the due date of the installment after the deferred one, which becomes the next due date | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `maturity_date` | the new final installment due date after the deferral | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `deferrals_used` | the loan's deferral count after this deferral | non-negative integer |
| `deferral_fee` | the deferral fee to book | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; stored at 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A receipt with `loan_id`, `status` (deferred), `next_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `maturity_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `deferrals_used`, `last_deferral_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today), `fee_txn_id` (reference number of the deferral fee entry), `deferral_fee` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `fees_due` (USD, 2 decimal places, fees not yet paid after the fee). Status deferred indicates the deferral was granted.
